author: cdc-rfc1-author (Claude Sonnet 5.5)
rationale: events.json requires a 12 ns event on a 10 ns unreset sampler. It spans one interval but falls below the 1.5-period margin of 15 ns: CDC-013(c) WARNING Unresolved.

author_reading.rationale: Required boundary event of 12 ns spans one 10 ns sampling interval but is below the 1.5-period (15 ns) review margin on a non-resettable sampler: delivery is neither proven nor refuted.

labels.rationale: The required 12 ns assertion exceeds the 10 ns ideal interval but falls below the 15 ns review margin. The exact reset-free sampler therefore retains a delivery obligation.

Per events.json, primary input req_pulse_i (design.sv:6, launched on src_clk) has protocol 'event', delivery 'required', and a minimum assertion duration of 12 ns when sampled by dst_clk (period 10.0 ns at p1_q, design.sv:14). Because 12 ns spans one ideal 10.0 ns period but falls below the 1.5x review margin (15.0 ns), sampling safety under jitter/setup-hold uncertainty remains unresolved (CDC-013 WARNING Unresolved).
